brief.title: Cinematic motif visual proof
brief.objective: Visually inspect adaptive motif choreography, staggered motion, foreground depth and day/night/light behavior.

document.title: Cinematic motif visual proof
document.logline: Visually inspect adaptive motif choreography, staggered motion, foreground depth and day/night/light behavior.

visual_style.visual_rules: Movement follows story beats; stillness is intentional and set depth remains fixed.
visual_style.palette: Neutral set with a rust performer and teal product.
visual_style.lighting: Atmosphere profile plus robot-light pose; BR60 brightness and CCT are manual setup.
visual_style.wardrobe: Visitor remains in rust across actor shots.
visual_style.sound: Simulation has no recorded production sound.
continuity_locks: Set objects do not move to fake parallax.
Hardware is not actuated by this showcase.
